title: Apologise and give the fix time
text: Apologise, tell the customer when the area network will be fixed, and offer a small goodwill data bonus if policy allows.
when: Customer reports no or slow internet and a network notice exists for the customer's area.

title: Offer the bigger 30-day pack (sample)
text: The customer runs out of data before the pack ends every month. Offer the bigger 30-day pack.
when: Customer's usage pattern shows the data runs out early, and the customer's main problem is being handled.

title: Deactivate the service and raise a refund
text: Confirm with the customer, deactivate the value-added service, then raise a refund request.
when: Customer disputes a charge they did not knowingly activate.

title: Suggest a roaming pack
text: Explain how to activate roaming in MyGP and suggest a roaming pack that fits the trip.

title: Verify identity, then block the SIM
text: Verify identity and block the SIM first. Then explain the documents needed for replacement.
when: Customer says the SIM is lost or stolen.
